description: This Java source file defines the ResponseCollectorActor class, an Akka actor responsible for collecting command responses, handling timeouts, and managing response counts for messaging within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes nested classes for managing output data and input signals, as well as methods for responding to various message types.

classes.name: ResponseCollectorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that collects command responses or exceptions over a configurable timeout, and reports the collected responses or errors to the original sender.

classes.name: ResponseCollectorActor.Output
classes.description: Encapsulates the collected command responses, providing methods to access all responses, successful responses, failed responses, and to check if all expected responses have arrived.

classes.name: ResponseCollectorActor.Input
classes.description: Marker interface for input signals sent to the actor.

classes.name: ResponseCollectorActor.Query
classes.description: Singleton indicator for a query message requesting the current collected responses.

classes.name: ResponseCollectorActor.SetCount
classes.description: Message class to set the expected number of responses the actor should wait for.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines how the actor handles incoming messages, setting up handlers for timeouts, queries, response counts, responses, and exceptions.
